title: WorldBankMacroAdapter fetchVnMacroBatch — same sequential-loop timeout pattern as FRED (now fixed)
summary: WorldBankMacroAdapter.fetchVnMacroBatch iterates 7 indicators sequentially with 1.5-2.5s sleep per call, producing 10-17s total latency. The 8s per-source budget in fetch-external-macro.ts is exceeded unconditionally. worldBank shows timeout in every smoke run. Same root cause as the FRED fix just merged (task/fred-parallelize-fetch-all-macro). Pattern: replace sequential for-loop + sleepMs with Promise.all — identical fix, different adapter.
pattern: fetchVnMacroBatch sequential for-loop + sleep — 7 indicators x 1.5-2.5s = 10-17s vs 8s budget
recommended_fix: Replace sequential for-of + sleepMs with Promise.all(indicators.map(...)) — same pattern as FRED fix in e777d83e. World Bank API: 10 req/10s public limit, 7 parallel calls is well within budget.
